text: The SEC has not standardized the disclosures required in Form PF, and there is evidence that Form PF requirements rest on an inconsistent use of industry terms, which can in turn produce inconsistent and contradictory data reporting.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy

abstract: The SEC has not yet standardized the required disclosures in Form PF and there is some evidence that the disclosure requirements in Form PF are based on an inconsistent use of industry terms which may in turn result in inconsistent and perhaps contradictory data reporting.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: Form PF as promulgated and in effect at the time of writing
